description:
Red Horizon Pact

Faction Description

Spoiler
“Nothing can have value without being an object of utility.”
During the darkest hours of the Second AI War, the Hegemony covertly gathered anti–Tri-Tachyon militants—saboteurs, dissidents, terrorists —and funneled them into Tri-Tachyon space. Among them was the renowned communist revolutionary Ubiystvo Kongxiang, whose uncompromising ideology and strategic brilliance made him a symbol of proletarian resistance.
Upon landing on the industrial world of Morozov, Kongxiang swiftly seized leadership of the planet’s local communist party and ignited a socialist uprising against the Zinoviev System Authorites. The revolution spread with mechanical precision: factories revolted, workers’ militias mobilized, and the old regime collapsed. As General Secretary, Kongxiang then launched the “liberation” of the Chunqiao system during the chaos of the Artemisia Sun coup, further expanding the sphere of revolutionary influence. His triumph was cut short when he was assassinated with an icepick—officially by an unknown agent, though the Party chronicles insist it was the work of reactionary elements.
Emerging from this crucible of upheaval, the Red Horizon Pact (RHP) declared itself the rightful vanguard of the Persean sectors workers. Built on the population, industrial might, and ideological rigor of Morozov, the Pact reorganized its territories into a constellation of People’s Republics, each under the control of the Communist Party of Morozov. Vanguardist communism is the sole lawful ideology, and class consciousness is preserved and protected through sealed borders, rigorous political education, and the ever-watchful Main Directorate of Correctional Labour Camps.
The RHP’s economic and military doctrines revolve around the five-cycle plans. Which fixate on  aggressive unrelenting expansion of heavy manufacturing. Commissars are embedded within every regiment, ship, and work battalion to ensure ideological purity and unwavering revolutionary spirit. When not deployed for liberation campaigns, the Persean Sector’s People’s Navy participates in the systematic exploitation of Zinoviev’s colossal asteroid belt—save for the elite Gvardiya formations.
To the Red Horizon Pact, all non-socialist states are inherently fascist, or inevitably destined to become fascist, and thus must be “liberated”. The march toward universal proletarian unity is, in their view, not merely an ideological aspiration—it is historical inevitability.
